Open Source Maintainers: announcement rules

Maintainers share releases, ask for contributors and discuss sustainability.

  1. Announcing releases of your own open-source project is fine, once per release.
  2. Please do not cross-post the same announcement to more than one category.
  3. Don't use automated tools to post; a maintainer should write each announcement.

Thank you for maintaining software the rest of us depend on.
